plugins.name: KrystalClip
plugins.description:
KrystalClip is a clipping processor featuring three distinct saturation algorithms
                               for controlled peak limiting. Each mode provides different harmonic characteristics,
                               from transparent loudness control to creative saturation, making it suitable for
                               mixing, mastering, and sound design applications.
plugins.catalogDescription: Four clipping algorithms for everything from transparent peak control to creative saturation.
features: Four clipping modes with different harmonic colorations
Threshold control for clipping point adjustment
Slope control to shape the clipping curve
Delta mode for precise clipping control
Automatic loudness matching with informative feedback
Real-time waveform display with short-term LUFS metering

specifications.value: Windows 10 or later, macOS 10.13 or later

plugins.name: KrystalComp
plugins.description: KrystalComp is a precision digital compressor for mixing and mastering. It combines surgical control over dynamics with flexible sidechain processing, offering downward and upward compression with RMS and Peak detection to suit any source material.
plugins.catalogDescription: A precision compressor for mix and mastering, with downward and upward modes and a flexible sidechain EQ.
features: Threshold, Ratio, Attack, Release and variable Knee
Hold and Range for precise dynamics control
Sidechain EQ: HP, LP and bell with adjustable slope and Q
Internal or external sidechain with Mid/Max link
Input, output and gain reduction metering

plugins.name: KrystalField
plugins.description:
KrystalField is a mastering-grade dynamic processor featuring dual compression
                               engines for simultaneous downward and upward compression. This approach provides
                               precise control over mix dynamics, making it suitable for mastering, bus processing,
                               and final mix polish.

plugins.name: KrystalPeak
plugins.description: KrystalPeak is a transparent digital limiter designed to suppress peaks and maximize loudness. Shape transients with precision while maintaining clarity, impact, and mix integrity.

plugins.name: KrystalShaper
plugins.description: KrystalShaper is an advanced transient processor that allows precise shaping of transient and sustain characteristics. Ideal for enhancing percussive elements, adding punch to drums, and controlling dynamics in complex mixes.
plugins.catalogDescription: Shape transient and sustain independently to bring punch, definition and control to a mix.
features: Three shaping modes for different material and workflows
Pump control to attenuate the signal right after the transient
Hold and Release controls to shape transient and sustain timing
Threshold control to set the onset detection range for transients
Sidechain panel with internal/external input and HP/LP filters
Independent HP/LP filters for each part to shape the response
Stereo-linked, Left/Right and Mid/Side channel linking modes
Lookahead option adding a short delay, for use on instruments
Delta mode to listen to what the plugin is adding or removing
Automatic loudness matching with informative feedback
Comprehensive transient and sustain gain meters

home.title: About Krystal Dynamics
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Nick - the developer behind Krystal Dynamics.
Krystal Dynamics is an independent audio software project focused on building clean, precise and professional tools for modern mixing and mastering.

The project started during my graduation in Sound and Music Computing at the University of Milan (UniMI), Italy. As a solo developer, these plugins represent several months of work exploring digital signal processing and have evolved into a suite of practical tools for producers and engineers.

Every plugin is designed, developed, tested and maintained entirely by me. I put strong emphasis on sound quality, CPU efficiency and workflow simplicity, avoiding unnecessary complexity while keeping full control over the dynamics.

I believe that professional tools should be accessible to everyone, which is why all plugins are completely free. However, developing and maintaining audio software requires a significant amount of time, research and continuous improvement.
User feedback and community support play a fundamental role in allowing this project to grow and continue evolving.

story.title: Where it started
paragraphs: Krystal Dynamics began as my graduation project in Sound and Music Computing at the University of Milan. What started as an exploration of digital signal processing grew into a suite of practical tools for producers and engineers.
The original focus was dynamic processing for mixing and mastering. That work continues to shape the design philosophy of the tools I make.

story.title: The process
paragraphs: I design, develop, test and maintain every plugin myself. The work focuses on sound quality, CPU efficiency and a clear workflow that is easy to understand and use.
Each tool targets a specific aspect of dynamic processing. I analyse every plugin's response myself and fine-tune it until it reaches the intended behaviour.

story.title: Free to use
paragraphs: All plugins are free for personal and commercial use. I maintain the project independently and keep the tools accessible to everyone.
Feedback from the people who use them helps me debug and shapes the ideas behind the next tools I build.
